facts.business: Federal-Mogul Goetze India Limited is a world class manufacturer of pistons, piston rings, sintered components, and cylinder liners, delivering advanced engine solutions for automotive and industrial applications across India and global markets.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Provisions and contingencies relating to litigations. The Company has recognised provisions aggregating ₹ 360.24 lacs and disclosed contingent liabilities of ₹ 10,720.99 lacs related to these litigations as at 31 March 2026.

key_risks: Provisions and contingencies relating to litigations involving direct taxes, indirect taxes, and labour laws pending with various authorities and courts in India.
facts.related_party_note: Promoters include TPR Co., Ltd., Federal-Mogul UK Investments Limited and Federal-Mogul Goetze (India) Ltd.
